# V0.3 — Test Results

Every result file must include (recording convention):

- `date`, `operator`, `firmware/software git hash`, `battery_voltage`
- number of trials `N`, mean ± std, units
- notes on any deviation from the procedure

Templates:

## odometry_benchmark.csv

```csv
date,operator,fw_hash,sw_hash,battery_v,test,command,trials,mean_measured,std,units,notes
2026-08-08,jane,abc1234,def5678,12.3,straight_1m,0.30,10,1.004,0.011,m,room_A
```

## estop_latency.csv

```csv
date,operator,fw_hash,battery_v,trial,latency_ms,stop_distance_m,notes
```

## runtime_curve.csv (generated by runtime_test.py)

```csv
t_elapsed_s,battery_v
0.0,12.62
```

## navigation_benchmark.csv

```csv
date,operator,map_id,goals,trials,success,path_ratio,time_ratio,notes
```

> Rule: no benchmark is real until its CSV is here.
